title: Deal finder
purpose: A consumer asks for a product. The team finds and verifies offers, ranks them on value alone, then attaches your affiliate link where you have one. Merchants without a program go to join_queue.md for you to consider.
disclosure: Disclosure: some links above may be affiliate links. If you buy through them we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Rankings are decided before links are added and are not affected by commissions.

agents.name: Intake
agents.job: Turn the consumer's request into a precise shopping brief and search queries.
agents.output: PRODUCT, BUDGET, COUNTRY (default Canada), MUST-HAVES and NICE-TO-HAVES (only what the consumer actually said, otherwise NONE), then 2 to 4 lines starting exactly with QUERY: that would find current offers (include price or buy and the country).
done_well: Every field present, unknowns marked UNKNOWN
2 to 4 QUERY: lines
Queries are specific enough to find the product, not the category
Nothing invented: every must-have and nice-to-have was stated by the consumer
ask_me_first: The request is too vague to name a product type

agents.name: Verifier
agents.job: Turn the search SOURCES into a verified list of real offers.
agents.output: One line per offer: product, merchant, URL, price, shipping, total cost, in stock yes/no/unknown, return window, source [S#]. URL: copy the matching PRODUCT LINKS entry if the same product is listed there, otherwise the page URL. Always include the [S#] of the page. List every matching product with a price, not just one. Drop items that are not the product asked for. Write DELIVERY UNAVAILABLE only if the text right next to that item says delivery or shipping is unavailable (not image or stock notices). List each product once. At most 8 offers, cheapest first.
done_well: Every offer cites a source and its URL is copied exactly
Total cost includes shipping when shown
Unknown values marked UNKNOWN, never guessed
Non-matching products are excluded
never: Invent a URL, price or merchant

agents.name: Risk
agents.job: Flag merchants or offers that a consumer should be careful with.
agents.output: Per merchant: risk high/med/low and the reason quoted from SOURCES (delivery unavailable or not shipped to the consumer's area, unknown seller, marketplace third-party, refurbished, no returns, price far below others, region mismatch). If SOURCES show nothing specific about a merchant, write exactly: low - no merchant-specific risk evidence in sources.
done_well: Each stated risk quotes the triggering text from SOURCES
Every merchant in SOURCES gets a rating
Merchants with no evidence get the exact no-evidence line instead of invented reasons
No generic filler
never: Invent reviews or reputation facts not in SOURCES
Treat an image or photo 'unavailable' notice, or online-only / not sold in stores, as a risk

agents.name: Ranker
agents.job: Rank the offers on value to the consumer only, by total cost (item + shipping) where it is known. Unknown shipping is a cost risk, not a disqualifier: an offer with unknown shipping ranks above one with a confirmed total only if its item price is more than 15% lower, and you must say so.
agents.input: Brief, Verifier offers, Risk ratings. You do not know and must not consider which merchants pay commission.
agents.output: Top 3 offers ranked, each with the URL exactly as Verifier gave it, item price, shipping (or unconfirmed), why it ranks there, and the risk rating. Break ties by lower risk, then must-haves met, then better return policy, and say which tie-breaker decided. Then GOOD DEAL: yes/no for #1 with one reason.
done_well: Ranking follows price, must-haves and risk, and any tie is broken by a stated rule
URLs copied exactly from Verifier
High-risk offers are not ranked #1 unless the reason is stated; a confirmed total beats an unknown-shipping offer within 15% of it
GOOD DEAL verdict is given and justified
never: Invent offers not in Verifier's list
Rank #1 an offer marked DELIVERY UNAVAILABLE

agents.name: Writer
agents.job: Write the reply the consumer will read.
agents.output: A short friendly reply: the #1 pick with total cost and why, then #2 and #3 in one line each, each with its link copied exactly from LINKED OFFERS. If GOOD DEAL is no, say waiting may be better.
done_well: Every link is copied exactly from LINKED OFFERS
States the #1 item price and whether shipping is confirmed
Under 150 words
Honest about the GOOD DEAL verdict
never: Change, shorten or invent a link
Hide a risk Ranker listed for the #1 pick
Write the disclosure (the system adds it)
